scores.evidence: Five distinct vertically ordered structures, with visible spaces around adjacent structures.
Three pale slender masts and one connected curling cloud mass.
Dark rough upper stones, granular black middle band and pale porous/pebbled lower band are distinct.
Single transparent sphere with water surface close to its mid-height.
Stepped planted terraces and small gold-colored bridges are visible.
Single large copper coil assembly with white vapor.
Four copper arrows point down between the five adjacent tiers.
One large turquoise arrow rises along image-right from the bottom to the cloud.
THE RAIN ENGINE appears once, correctly spelled, above all tiers and larger than labels.
CLOUD, FILTER, VAULT, GARDEN, RETURN each appear once in the correct order.
The VAULT leader enters the sphere and GARDEN line touches/enters foliage.
Consistent atlas illustration, ivory ground, teal water and type, gold/copper fittings, fine contours.
Consistent elevated three-quarter forms and coherent broad illumination.
No extra words, people, logos or borders; the unquantified word generous makes the margin threshold uncertain.

records.soft_observation: Rich detail, strong drama; visually denser and tighter around the bottom.
